build.beforeDevCommand: sh -c 'if [ -d web ]; then cd web; elif [ -d ../web ]; then cd ../web; fi; exec npm run dev'
build.beforeBuildCommand: sh -c 'if [ -d web ]; then cd web; elif [ -d ../web ]; then cd ../web; fi; exec npm run build'

security.csp: default-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:*; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: asset:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:* ws://127.0.0.1:*; frame-src about: data:

bundle.longDescription: Desktop control plane for caos-agent-harness: multi-agent orchestration, isolated git worktrees, policy guardrails, MCP memory, and live SSE traces.
